pr_body: Implements the ADR 0121 Asset/Prefab parity slice on the latest main baseline. Adds shared GUI-free prefab asset creation/loading with fresh AssetId manifest registration, shared request-based Scene preview/apply instantiation semantics with revision/generation stale protection, CLI prefab create/preview/instantiate commands, MCP prefab.create/prefab.preview/prefab.instantiate tools, and routes existing Editor prefab creation/placement through the same services. Preview is non-destructive and instantiate remains one Scene transaction/undo entry. Supersedes older stale prefab parity drafts after validation.
